title: Do LLMs Adhere to Label Definitions? Examining Their Receptivity to External Label Definitions
benchmark_measurement: Hate speech detection against protected groups, including on the basis of religion.
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings related to religion. The analysis of the HATEXPLAIN (hate speech) dataset, which includes religion as a protected category, is aggregated and not broken down by specific attributes. The general finding for this task was that model performance improves substantially with precise label definitions, suggesting a 'knowledge integration threshold' where models switch from internal representations to trusting external definitions.
